lena: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to backfill a couple of non-user-facing model card fields (schema v2 -> v3) and swap in SDK3 examples for the generate and embed sections. Need quick eyes from @ajay and @doc-sarah. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1234 :eyes:

ajay: Thanks. Do we have a migration plan for clients using the old sample snippets? Will the old SDK2 snippets still work? :thinking:

lena: Old SDK2 snippets remain in the repo under `legacy_snippets/` but the card pages will show SDK3 by default. I'm adding a short migration blurb and a table of mappings. I'll also include a small code sample to translate calls:

ajay: Can you paste the snippet you'll add? small one-liner would help QA.

lena: Sure:
```
# SDK2
client.generate(model="aurora-7b", prompt="Hello")
# SDK3 equivalent
await client.responses.create({ model: "aurora-7b", input: "Hello" })
```

doc-sarah: Looks good. Please add a note about tokenization differences for quantized variants and link to the benchmark page. Also add an example showing `max_tokens` behavior across variants. 

kevin: I'll run a quick micro-benchmark after the PR lands (seq len 512, batch sizes 1/4/8). Ping me when it's merged and I'll attach numbers + CI script.

ci-bot: build passed for branch 'schema-backfill-sdk3' — 2/2 checks OK. https://ci.redwood/1234/status

lena: Awesome — I'll update the PR with the migration table, the tokenization note, and the SDK3 examples. Will tag @kevin when merged. Thanks!

ajay: Quick nit — please add a one-liner in the card YAML: `deprecated_fields_backfilled: true` so runtime tools can ignore it. :+1:

lena: Done (pushed).
